_comment: Beyond-the-code section. Extracted 1:1 from the hand-written v1 index.html #life section.
quote: I am not just an engineer. I am someone who ice-skated alone in a Montréal winter, learned bachata from scratch, walked from Little Italy to Berri-UQAM, and cooked every single meal I've eaten this year. The code is part of it — not all of it.

bento.title: Dancer & Raver
bento.desc: Bachata, electronic music festivals, sweaty rooms with strangers — this is where I feel most alive. Piknik Électronik all summer. Igloo Fest in winter. Solo, always.

bento.title: Hybrid Athlete
bento.desc: Gym, running, hiking, calisthenics. Physical discipline is how I think clearly.

bento.title: Language Collector
bento.desc: Tamil (native), English (advanced), French (B1). Languages unlock worlds.

bento.title: Home Cook
bento.desc: Every meal, from scratch. Meal prep is a meditation. Eats outside once every 2–3 months.

bento.title: Philosophy
bento.desc: Consciousness is the point of being human. Reads, journals, thinks deeply.

bento.title: Explorer
bento.desc: India → Montréal. Montréal → Toronto (twice). Walks that last hours. New discomforts, always solo.

bento.title: The Happy Glitch
bento.desc: Documenting the honest version of a grad student life in Montréal. The solo adventures, the discipline, the waking up. Building in public, quietly, letting results speak.

bento.title: Reader
bento.desc: Biographies, philosophy, history, spirituality. Loves cultures and the "why" behind everything.
